statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The physician ordered 93229 to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies
The diagnosis codes are G45.9 and R42
